name: 22611 · Berryville, VA
findings: ZIP 22611 (Berryville) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22611 (Berryville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
